title: Two-out-of-three external cup comparison for a right coefficient sequence
statement: Let k be a field [def-weil-field], X and Y quasi-compact k-schemes [def-pc-scheme] with affine diagonals, F a quasi-coherent module on X [pqf-def-coherent], and S a short exact sequence of quasi-coherent modules on Y [def-sp-abelian]. Specify normalized cochain realizations c1, c2, c3 [lem-sc-picard-external-cup-cochain] on the scalar resolution models [lem-sc-picard-kunneth-resolution-model] for its three coefficients. If H^m(c2) and H^m(c3) are invertible for every natural degree m, then H^n(c1) is invertible for any natural degree n. This is an exact-sequence transfer statement without bounds, an acyclic embedding, or an induction hypothesis.

source.place: Tag 0BED, lemma-kunneth, short exact sequence paragraph following equation 33.29.1.1 and the same argument in the right coefficient

proof.text: Obtain the exact five-term comparison ladder from the right exact-ladder theorem. Apply the hypotheses for c2 and c3 to its outside-arrow clause. The four outside vertical maps are isomorphisms.
An isomorphism is both epi and mono. Apply the categorical five lemma to the exact rows to obtain an isomorphism of their middle objects.

Substitute the middle-arrow equation, which is conjugation of H^n(c1) by eA.hom and eB.inv. Cancel these two isomorphisms with Mathlib isIso_comp_right_iff and isIso_comp_left_iff to conclude IsIso of H^n(c1).

proof_origin.place: Tag 0BED; C3 extracted the exact homology ladder and formalized the categorical five-lemma application separately. The official Stacks tag page was read because this machine does not have the literature checkout.

theorem picardExternalCupCochain_isIso_of_right_shortExact
    (k : Type w) [Field k] (X Y : Scheme.{w})
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (g : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
    [CompactSpace X] [CompactSpace Y]
    [IsAffineHom (pullback.diagonal f)] [IsAffineHom (pullback.diagonal g)]
    (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent]
    (S : ShortComplex Y.Modules) (hS : S.ShortExact)
    [S.X₁.IsQuasicoherent] [S.X₂.IsQuasicoherent] [S.X₃.IsQuasicoherent]
    (c1 : picardExternalTotal f g F S.X₁ ⟶
      picardScalarModel (pullback.fst f g ≫ f) (externalCupCoefficients f g F S.X₁))
    (hc1 : IsPicardExternalCupCochain f g F S.X₁ c1)
    (c2 : picardExternalTotal f g F S.X₂ ⟶
      picardScalarModel (pullback.fst f g ≫ f) (externalCupCoefficients f g F S.X₂))
    (hc2 : IsPicardExternalCupCochain f g F S.X₂ c2)
    (c3 : picardExternalTotal f g F S.X₃ ⟶
      picardScalarModel (pullback.fst f g ≫ f) (externalCupCoefficients f g F S.X₃))
    (hc3 : IsPicardExternalCupCochain f g F S.X₃ c3)
    (h2 : ∀ n : ℕ, IsIso (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap c2 (n : ℤ)))
    (h3 : ∀ n : ℕ, IsIso (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap c3 (n : ℤ)))
    (n : ℕ) : IsIso (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap c1 (n : ℤ))
